title: Hearty Steam Cooked Ethiopian Lentils Shiro
description: A traditional Ethiopian dish made with red lentils and served with a side of injera, this shiro is a hearty and comforting meal, featuring a unique jammy texture from the steam cooking process and a romantic presentation in a donabe vessel.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour and spices to make the shiro mixture.
In a large donabe or steam cooker, heat the oil over medium heat.
Add the onion, garlic, and ginger to the pot and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the lentils, water, and shiro mixture to the pot, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and steam, covered, for 30 minutes.
Stir the mixture occasionally to prevent sticking and promote even cooking.
After 30 minutes, remove the lid and check the consistency of the shiro, it should be thick and jammy.
If the shiro is too thick, add a little water, if it's too thin, simmer for a few more minutes.
Serve the shiro hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
